Research & projects

01

Grill Lab

Duke University · 2021–2024 · Durham, NC

Worked under the Sacral Nerve Stimulation team at the Grill Lab developing computational tools to study the enteric nervous system. Built a MATLAB data analysis pipeline to extract derived variables from calcium fluorescence microscopy images of the moving gut. Developed a CNN to improve calcium imaging analysis, contributing to a peer-reviewed publication. Created an ML model characterizing sensitivity and synchronization in an enteric neural oscillator, presented at Triangle SFN. This work sits at the intersection of neuroscience and GI medicine, with implications for understanding motility disorders and the gut-brain axis.

Barth BB, Redington ER, Gautam N, et al. Calcium image analysis in the moving gut. Neurogastroenterol Motil. 2023.
Gautam N, Barth BB, Grill WM. Sensitivity and synchronization in an enteric neural oscillator. Triangle Society for Neuroscience. 2023.
Computational NeuroscienceMLPublication ↗Abstract + Poster Presentation ↓

02

UnitedHealth Group

2024–2026 · New York, NY

Built PRIM (Predictive Renewal Increase Model) from the ground up — an end-to-end LightGBM regression and classification pipeline that predicts pricing outcomes and renewal probabilities for small business insurance groups across Employer & Individual segment. PRIM replaced existing infrastructure and was deployed nationwide across all small business markets. Presented the full development, pilot, and rollout to leadership and underwriters across the country. Received 3 Innovation Awards.
